new_controls.name: Evidence provenance and claim lifecycle
new_controls.finding: Unsupported incident, loss, attribution, and efficacy claims lack reproducible provenance.
new_controls.acceptance: A reviewer can reproduce each accepted claim from its artifacts. Missing or contradictory evidence leaves the claim pending; two articles repeating one disclosure are one evidence chain.

new_controls.name: Versioned assessment and compatibility governance
new_controls.finding: Conflicting CTRS models, ranges, schemas, and tables produce incompatible decisions.
new_controls.acceptance: Reject missing model versions, out-of-range inputs, incompatible consumers, and unpublished formula changes. Reproduce historical records without silently recalculating them.

new_controls.name: Financial authority inventory
new_controls.finding: Key inventories omit approvals, permits, modules, delegates, sessions, signers, and recovery powers.
new_controls.acceptance: Reconcile the inventory against deployed configuration and observed grants. A deliberately added module or unused permit must be found; unknown authority prevents declaring the account fully assessed.

new_controls.name: Authority revocation and recovery verification
new_controls.finding: Revoking an allowance or stopping an app can leave keys, signatures, or delegates active.
new_controls.acceptance: After revocation, attempts through each removed path fail under its documented semantics. Test unused signatures, a pending request, alternate chains, and compromised recovery credentials. Record paths that cannot be invalidated immediately.

new_controls.name: Hardware procurement and whole-device trust
new_controls.finding: Authentic firmware or a secure element does not establish whole-device integrity.
new_controls.acceptance: Document the result and coverage of each supported check. A genuine component with an unassessed display or altered setup process cannot pass a claim of whole-device integrity.

new_controls.name: Aggregate exposure budget enforcement
new_controls.finding: Per-wallet balances and transaction-count limits do not bound principal-wide financial exposure.
new_controls.acceptance: Two concurrent requests that are individually allowed but exceed the combined budget cannot both succeed. Test wallet splitting, replenishment, retries, bridge routes, pending reservations, stale prices, and policy outages.

new_controls.name: Bridge backing and redemption invariants
new_controls.finding: A valid cross-chain message can still create an unbacked or nonredeemable claim.
new_controls.acceptance: A correctly authenticated message that mints beyond supported backing must fail the exposure gate. Test replay, conflicting finality, collateral shortfall, unavailable redemption, and a malicious upgrade. Do not infer solvency from a reserve snapshot.

new_controls.name: Independent human financial authorization
new_controls.finding: A human gate is ineffective if the agent controls approval, recovery, or policy administration.
new_controls.acceptance: Reject agent self-approval, compromised approval-session reuse, replay, changed calldata, expired approval, and attempts to recover or replace the approver. Record the exact signing payload and approval evidence.

new_controls.name: Agent shutdown and persistent-authority containment
new_controls.finding: Process shutdown leaves on-chain permissions, signed intents, and signing-service credentials usable.
new_controls.acceptance: After shutdown, new requests, queued retries, spawned workers, cached credentials, and delegated sessions cannot create new unauthorized exposure. Explicitly report uncancellable signed or broadcast actions and residual harm.

new_controls.name: Bounded emergency authority
new_controls.finding: Generic timelock overrides can become unrestricted transfer or upgrade authority.
new_controls.acceptance: An emergency actor can perform only the intended pause/cancel actions. Arbitrary transfers, upgrades, self-extension, and removal of oversight fail. Test expiry, loss of a responder, and safe restoration.

new_controls.name: Governance capture and lasting-authority review
new_controls.finding: Temporary voting power or delegated influence may grant lasting control.
new_controls.acceptance: Exercise a temporary voting-power scenario that attempts to install a lasting admin, module, or emergency role. Demonstrate the prevention or detection/cancellation boundary and record any residual capture path.

new_controls.name: Custody liabilities and asset-rights assessment
new_controls.finding: On-chain balances and custody labels do not establish liabilities, legal title, or redemption.
new_controls.acceptance: Test an omnibus-custody case, reserve/liability mismatch, issuer freeze, redemption suspension, and insolvency scenario. Missing evidence remains unknown rather than receiving a safe rating.
